'''Light's Point''' is the beach to the east of [[Havenshire]] in the [[Scarlet Enclave]]. [[Admiral Barean Westwind]]'s doomed fleet has made berth along the shores, and a guard tower located on the bluffs west and above the beach is occupied by [[Argent Dawn]] members of the [[Brotherhood of the Light]] led by [[Joshua Ambercrest]].
